newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Citibank issuing A$150 million TCDs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Citibank issuing A$150 million TCDs.

text.p: Citibank Ltd said on Tuesday that it is issuing A$150 million of transferable certificates of deposit.
The issue would mature in March 2002 and would be priced over the equivalent government bond on Thursday, August 21 at an indicated spread of 33-35 basis points over, Citbank said.
The coupon would be 7.0 percent, while settlement would be August 26.
Citisecurities is arranger and lead manager, while co-managers are Westpac Banking Corporation and Commonwealth Bank of Australia.
Citibank Ltd is the Australian arm of the U.S. based Citicorp group.
